documents.title: Notice Of The 41St Annual General Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On Wednesday, 30Th September, 2026 Through Video Conferencing, Other Audio-Visual Means (OAVM)

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Ltd reported a strong Q1 FY27 with a turnover of over 700 crores, achieving its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and a PAT of 20 crores. Despite trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May that lowered quarterly sales volumes to 5,200 tons, volumes normalized in June. The company is undergoing a corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into a new wholly owned subsidiary, Tieramet Limited, to unlock value. Management proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next two years (FY27 and FY28) and is targeting 12% to 15% volume growth for the full year. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance, achieving a revenue of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% going forward in the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: The company targets an export contribution of somewhere between 12% and 15% this year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects its value-added product percentage to end the year between 63% and 64%.
guidance.quote: In terms of our value-added percentage, we are looking at between 63% and 64% for this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of reaching 5,000 crores of revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: The company is aiming for a top line of 3,000 crores and plans to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year on an increased top line.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices for its projected growth.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: The company expects its minimum volume growth to be between 15% and 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase its value-added product share to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees a lot of demand as of today, with customers looking to increase volumes and talking about doubling capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the recycled copper market in India to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: The company foresees a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its capacity from 35,000 to 45,000 tons, expected to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is going to form a new wholly owned subsidiary called Tieramet Limited to hold all copper infrastructure and businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added another machine to its line for 48-conductor CTCs.
capex_expansion.quote: And recently, we have added another machine to our line for 48-conductor CTCs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's restructuring scheme includes the amalgamation of BCPL into BIL.
capex_expansion.quote: Amalgamation: BCPL merges into BIL; dissolved without winding up

capex_expansion.claim: The company is proposing a capex of about 40 crores in the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around 10 crores into a plastic recycling project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding recycling verticals for aluminium and plastic.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also adding recycling verticals of aluminium and plastic.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added new heat recovery systems that go live this year to increase fuel efficiency.
capex_expansion.quote: So we've also added new heat recovery systems that increase the fuel efficiency and decrease our cycle times on all our furnaces, and, that is going live this year.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved a revenue of over 700 crores. We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company was able to increase its margins in the first two months of the quarter due to trade route disruptions and material shortages.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins are more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms because purchases and sales are linked to LME.
margins_costs.quote: So, our margins are going to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.

margins_costs.claim: The removal of customs duty from January 1, 2025, has helped the company increase its margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43% in Q1FY27.
The company's value addition per kg was INR 116 in Q1FY27.
The company achieved an EBITDA of around 62 rupees per kg in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a pass-through mechanism of copper prices to finished products.
margins_costs.quote: We have a pass-through mechanism of the copper prices to the finished products.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an operational EBITDA margin of 46% and a PAT margin of 2.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Our operational EBITDA margin is 46%, our PAT margin is 2.1%, and our PE ratio is 17.71%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volume dropped to 5,200 tons for the quarter, with 2,200 tons coming in the month of June.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's CTC wire capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has two manufacturing units based in Hyderabad, consisting of a 4-acre facility and a 60-acre facility.
orders_capacity.quote: We have two manufacturing units based in Hyderabad. One is a 4-acre facility and another is a 60-acre facility.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has finalized the first round of fundraising at 52 crores, with the money expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans a second tranche of fundraising around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's projection shows that its debt will be around 325 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: The projection is showing that around 325 crores will be the debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company hedges approximately 85% of its inventory on the exchange.
capital_allocation.quote: However, approximately 85% of the inventory which is there is hedged on the exchange.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is raising Rs. 52.25 Crores through a preferential issue to non-promoters.
The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The increase in the company's equity was done entirely through retained earnings without dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's real estate value in books is roughly about 29 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The real estate value in books is roughly about 29 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced a GST impact of 17 crores due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced trade route disruptions and material shortages in April and May.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's sales volumes dropped to 5,278 tons, representing a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces risks related to the performance of the Indian and international economies, competition, and market risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the Company's ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company's future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cashflows, the Company's market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing of scrap from the Gulf has dried up and shipping lines have been diverted, causing delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India. That has got delayed.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects its volume in the first quarter to be marginally lower than the fourth quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: My volume in the first quarter might be marginally lower than fourth quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing will be one of the biggest challenges in recycling going forward due to growing competition.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, Adani and Hindalco announcing that they'll come into recycling is also going to be an issue going forward in future, because one of the biggest challenges in recycling is also sourcing.

management_commitments.claim: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete a digital transformation of every process and department over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete its restructuring after the NCLT hearing scheduled for August 7th.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, the NCLT hearing is scheduled for the 7th of August, after which we should soon be able to complete this restructuring.

management_commitments.claim: The company is proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase its value-added product share to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to execute a fundraise of roughly 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to double its turnover to 5,000 crores in 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
